tabId.description: Optional target Chrome tab ID (defaults to active tab)

waitDurationMs.description: Wait time in ms after each reload for DOM to settle (default: 2500)

cleanDomPath.description: File path to save clean native DOM snapshot HTML

injectedDomPath.description: File path to save injected DOM snapshot HTML

cleanScreenshotPath.description: File path to save clean native screenshot PNG

injectedScreenshotPath.description: File path to save injected screenshot PNG

diffOutputPath.description: File path to save JSON differential report

expectedBehavior: Captures and compares clean vs injected DOM state
